title: A filter on a calendar's year clears the filter on its month

source.quote: Context clearing happens on columns tagged in a calendar or associated sort-by columns regardless if the context is set using time intelligence functions or otherwise.
All category dependents of both X and its dependencies
source.supports: Year has no dependencies; Month depends on Quarter, which depends on Year (the lattice diagram), so Month is cleared

derivation: Setting Year clears Year's dependents: Quarter, Month, Week, Date. YearMonth is Gregorian's Month, so its filter goes and only Year = 2008 is left: every row, 662.
